name: CAVA Group
fiscalYearEnd: Last Sunday of December (FY2025 ended 2025-12-28; quarters are 12 or 16 weeks)
description: CAVA runs a fast-casual Mediterranean restaurant chain (customizable bowls and pitas) and sells its dips, spreads and dressings in grocery stores. It owns and runs every restaurant itself: 476 CAVA restaurants in 29 states and DC on 2026-07-12, up from 439 at the end of 2025. It makes the dips and dressings in central kitchens, which also supplies the stores. Growth is about 65-75 net new restaurants a year (72 in 2025) and management sees room for over 1,000 by 2032. The business is thin at the company level (operating margin about 4.7% in 2025) but restaurant-level profit margin is about 25%, with the gap being corporate costs, pre-opening costs and depreciation. Same-restaurant sales growth slowed to 4.0% in 2025 from 13.4%, then rebounded to 9.0% in Q2 2026.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not source-checked. SEC SIC code is 5812 (Retail-Eating Places). CAVA owns and operates its restaurants (it does not franchise), like Chipotle, unlike royalty-model chains in the same box.

employees.note: About 12,900 restaurant team members plus 580 in manufacturing and the Collaboration Center (support centre) organization (FY2025 10-K), summed

businessLines.name: CAVA restaurants
businessLines.shareBasis: Total company revenue (including CPG and other) was not extracted, so the share is not stated; company operating income $55.3M (4.7% of revenue implies total about $1.18B, inferred)
businessLines.how: Direct sale of meals to guests in stores (about 38% via digital orders), from which the company pays food, labour and occupancy costs; profit is what remains per store (restaurant-level profit) minus corporate costs.
businessLines.description: Company-operated fast-casual restaurants (including converted Zoes Kitchen sites and Hybrid Kitchens with a delivery-only area); excludes restaurants under license agreements and Digital Kitchens.

businessLines.how: Wholesale sales of packaged products to grocers; size not disclosed in the text read.
businessLines.description: CAVA-branded dips, spreads and dressings sold in grocery stores; also licensed restaurants and Digital Kitchens.
